To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a conditional gene targeting system to study GC B cell function.

we have developed a new mouse strain that allows to study gene function specifically and exclusively in germinal center B lymphocytes, which are the cells responsible for the generation of antibodies with high affinity and specificity.

Cgamma1- cre mice provide a powerful tool for tracking GC B cells in vivo, that GC B cells can transcribe more that one downstream C(H)-gene before undergoing CSR, and that the Cgamma1 -cre allele allows for the genetic analysis and the generation of compound mutants of GC B cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the generation of new mouse strains and their use to study gene function in germinal center B lymphocytes.
the molecular mechanisms of B cell differentiation.
the generation of high affinity, class-switched, antibodies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Cgamma1-germinal centre B cells (GC B cells) are the main sites for generating high-affinity, switched antibodies in T cell dependent (TD) antibody responses.
the Cgamma1 allele is a powerful tool for studying GC B cell function and class switching.
the Cgamma1-Cre mouse line is an excellent tool for the genetic manipulation of B cells in the germinal center and for the analysis of the molecular mechanisms that regulate class switching.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Cgamma1-Cre mouse is an important new tool to study the function of genes in GC B cells.
the Cgamma1 promoter can be used to drive the expression of Cre in B cells, and that this expression is induced upon activation of B cells and is maintained in GC B cells.
the Cgamma1-Cre mouse line provides an efficient and convenient tool for the genetic dissection of GC B cells and their immediate progeny.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Cgamma1 promoter is active in germinal center B-cells.
the Cgamma1 promoter can be used as a GC B cell-specific promoter to induce the expression of any gene of interest in GC B cells.
Cgamma1- cre mice are a powerful genetic tool for the analysis of GC B cell biology and for the tracking of class switched B cell memory and plasma cells in mice and humans.
